1. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __wherein the encoder is configured to signal the adapted mode mapping information in a bitstream__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence, __and wherein the update is based on coding information from the one or more previously encoded pictures__.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the actual parameters are used to dynamically adjust the mode mapping information prior to encoding the picture__.

9. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: encoding (740, 970) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence (740, 940, 960), __and signaling the adapted mode mapping information in a resultant bitstream__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence (550, 960), __and wherein the update is based on coding information from the one or more previously encoded pictures__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the picture is a currently coded picture, and the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence (940, 960), __wherein the actual parameters are used to dynamically adjust the mode mapping information prior to encoding the picture__.

17. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: a decoder (400) for decoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __wherein the decoder is configured to extract the adapted mode mapping information from a bitstream__.

23. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 17, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence, __and wherein the update is based on coding information from the one or more previously decoded pictures__.

24. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 17, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the actual parameters are used to dynamically adjust the mode mapping information prior to decoding the picture__.

25. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: decoding (820, 1030) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __and extracting the adapted mode mapping information from a resultant bitstream__.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 25, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence, __and wherein the update is based on coding information from the one or more previously decoded pictures__.

32. (Currently amended) The method of claim 25, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the actual parameters are used to dynamically adjust the mode mapping information prior to decoding the picture__.

33. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer-readable storage media having video signal data encoded thereupon, comprising: mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, __wherein the mode mapping information is signaled in a bitstream and is dynamically adapted based on coding information from one or more previously encoded pictures in the sequence__.
